# Vendored RTL

Code copied from upstream (`.git` files removed). Licenses are in the module
directories.

| Module | Upstream | Commit | License / local patches |
|---|---|---|---|
| jt51 (YM2151) | https://github.com/jotego/jt51 | 4a47f666b67b52b9016f390bcfe3255da0128762 | GPL-3.0 |
| jt49 (AY-3-8910/YM2149) | https://github.com/jotego/jt49 | 7f6abfd08a2af9a92dbd5b32c71ea773248a77e2 | GPL-3.0; таблицы громкости comp=0 и comp=1 заменены моделями чипов из libvgm (у jt49 там сжатие динамики, а не модель) |
| openfpga-litex (base core) | https://github.com/agg23/openfpga-litex | c21570d85260856c10f7b11c9e4d233c0fe65748 | MIT; m4pocket patch: the FpuCore module inside the generated VexRiscv cluster is replaced by a stub (outputs tied off, cmd_ready high). It cost 2564 ALMs — 14% of the device — and the firmware is built for rv32imac, so no floating-point instruction ever reaches it. Verified: 0 F/D instructions in the player binary. |
| apu.sv + regs_savestates.sv (NES APU) | https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/NES_MiSTer | 7f598210af8efb09237818d8a4d03e402daf9705 | GPL-3.0; 2 Verilator fixes (inlined constants, split dma_address) |
| verilog-6502 (Arlet Ottens) | https://github.com/Arlet/verilog-6502 | e930327ffecc5062bfce70bbcfba2bbfa6de6e4c | permissive (keep copyright) |
| VerilogBoy (SM83 + GB APU) | https://github.com/zephray/VerilogBoy (refactor branch) | ba256042fbd3274090df86828d84d09527559113 | OHDL 1.0; patches: module cpu renamed to vb_cpu (clash with Arlet); sound_noise.v — divider ratio 0 gave half the period it should, so noise ran an octave high for the most common drum setting (measured 65548 Hz against the reference 32768); sound.v — the mixer summed the four channels as unsigned 0..15, so a channel whose DAC was off sat at the bottom of the scale instead of the middle and every note that switched a DAC moved the DC, which the blocker downstream turned into a thump (Densha de Go! on Game Boy Color: +15.7 dB against the reference in 40-80 Hz, +21 dB at 20 Hz). The DAC now follows SameBoy: a channel contributes 0xF - 2*sample when its DAC is on and exactly zero when it is off, and the master volume multiplier is NR50+1 (1..8) rather than NR50 (0..7), so volume 0 is quiet rather than silent |
| SID (sid_top et al.) | https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/C64_MiSTer (rtl/sid; DAC/filters based on Dag Lem's reDIP-SID/reSID) | 95d3a23867ed52e8655ee85eb950cb9b99a1c044 | GPL/CERN-OHL-S; Verilator fixes: wire arrays -> localparam, wire -> input in function ports, wire -> logic for procedural arrays |
| opl3_fpga (YMF262) | https://github.com/gtaylormb/opl3_fpga | 491a4dc9bb25c33e0183caaf683102b9ce273bc1 | LGPL-3.0; m4pocket patches: NUM_BANKS=1 (OPL2 subset for area, opl3_pkg), BANK_WIDTH guard for 1 bank (mem_multi_bank*), three bank-1 hardcodes -> NUM_BANKS-1 (channels.sv, control_operators.sv, calc_envelope_shift.sv — the envelope timer ticked only after bank 1, so with one bank no envelope ever decayed); envelope_generator.sv — the tremolo enable `am` was read unpipelined, i.e. from whichever operator was being fetched two stages later, so tremolo only worked when every operator had AM set; vibrato.sv + calc_phase_inc.sv — the LFO counted operator slots instead of samples (109 Hz with one bank, 6.07 Hz correct) and the offset was added after the block shift and multiplier; rewritten after Nuked OPL3 (offset into F-number before the shift, Nuked step shape), measured 6.12 Hz and the same ±10 cents as emu2413 at F-number 342; earlier: CDC in host_if, CLK_DIV_COUNT=256 instead of $ceil, trick_sw_detection |
| GENMIDI lump (GM patches for OPL) | https://github.com/freedoom/freedoom (lumps/genmidi, mkgenmidi build) | — | BSD-3-Clause |
| jt12 (YM2612/OPN2) | https://github.com/jotego/jt12 | eaab7e1de6594982a299bc9101dc882384b85685 | GPL-3.0 |
| jt89 (SN76489) | https://github.com/jotego/jt89 | b688c5767f4b5910c43f4c2b3909142156a8f584 | GPL-3.0; m4pocket patches, both additive and default-compatible: noise feedback taps and shift-register width made inputs (`fb_mask`, `sr15`) instead of the hardcoded Master System pair, since the SN76489AN of the SG-1000, the arcades and the BBC Micro uses 15 bits with taps 0 and 1 and the VGM header carries the choice; and the raw pre-volume square of each channel is brought out (`raw0..raw3`) so the attenuation can be applied per side outside, which is what Game Gear panning and the two attenuator banks of the T6W28 need. Defaults reproduce the previous behaviour bit for bit — verified on 96022 samples |
| font8x8 (UI font) | https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8 | — | Public Domain |
| IKASCC (Konami SCC / K051649) | https://github.com/ika-musume/IKASCC | 5d07811350621de275b56f3ff88c439d0973521d | BSD-2-Clause; used with IMPL_TYPE=0 (sync). Files: IKASCC.v + IKASCC_player_s.v + IKASCC_vrc_s.v + IKASCC_primitives.v (the *_a async variants are kept for upstream fidelity but unused) |
| jt6295 (OKIM6295) | https://github.com/jotego/jt6295 | 65a5fe118c89173350ce0fc20aa9d06927f46676 | GPL-3.0; used with INTERPOL=0 (INTERPOL>0 would pull jtframe_fir_mono). Sample ROM streamed from PSRAM via the chipbox arbiter |
| jt053260 (Konami K053260) | https://github.com/jotego/jtcores (modules/jt053260) | jt053260.v/_channel.v/_timer.v; jtframe_limsum.v from modules/jtframe/hdl/sound | GPL-3.0; m4pocket patch: added `parameter NUMCH=4` and wrapped channels 3-4 in `generate if(NUMCH>2)` — instantiated with NUMCH=2 to fit FPGA area (see docs/chips.md). 4 channels, each with its own ROM port; all served from one PSRAM window by a round-robin fetcher in the chipbox arbiter |
